description: The epanet-js browser application edits INP networks and runs hydraulic models with maps, pressure and flow views. Projects run and save locally by default, with optional cloud services. This resource is provided by epanet-js team (Luke Butler and Sam Paya named as co-founders). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Functional Source License (FSL), becoming MIT after two years. The browser service has optional paid cloud features. Limitation: The application and its JavaScript toolkit are distinct resources. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
